title: SPARC Segmentation Conversion: Binary Mask Tracings to MBF XML
author: Maci Heal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bchjit4n

steps.title: Open binary mask tracings
steps.instruction: Open the binary mask tracings (.tif) into the program window.

steps.title: Activate Outline Objects tool
steps.instruction: Select the Outline Objects icon from the Trace ribbon.

steps.title: Contour representative objects
steps.instruction: Automatically contour the representative objects by clicking on a black or white pixel on the binary mask tracings.

substeps.instruction: Click on a black or white pixel to contour the object
Repeat the process until all objects are contoured

steps.title: Configure subject metadata and criteria
steps.instruction: Add subject metadata and select criteria for the anatomic term list within the SPARC Vocabulary Services welcome dialog.

steps.title: Assign vocabulary terms
steps.instruction: Choose the appropriate vocabulary term from the contour selection toolbar.
